observations: Photo 0 shows a pile of used car engines and engine components in a cluttered outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
One engine has a visible silver valve cover with 'HONDA' embossed on it.
Another engine has a black plastic cover with a ribbed design, possibly a timing cover or intake manifold.
The engines appear dirty, with oil residue, grime, and exposed wiring.
A person's legs are visible on the right edge of the photo, suggesting the photo was taken in a workshop or scrapyard.
No visible branding or model numbers on the engines themselves.
The seller claims to deal in car spare parts, but the photo shows only used engines, not spare parts like alternators, sensors, or filters.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only used engines; no spare parts are visible. The claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

risks.risk: Engines may be damaged, non-functional, or have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., internal wear, cracked block, seized components).
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the engine block, cylinder head, and internal components (e.g., oil pan, crankshaft, pistons) to check for damage or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or severely damaged

risks.risk: The engines may not be from the specified brand or model, or may be from a different vehicle than claimed.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the engine block with visible casting numbers or VIN tags, or a photo of the engine's serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used engines, not branded

risks.risk: The engines may be stolen or salvaged without proper documentation.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine's serial number and any documentation (e.g., salvage certificate, title) if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced with risk of legal or warranty issues

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photos of the engine block showing casting numbers or serial numbers.
Photos of the engine's internal components (e.g., oil pan, cylinder head) to check for damage.
Photos of any documentation or proof of origin if available.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
